edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address of every transfer, so caller identity drives balance mutation
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of funds
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when decreasing allowance
setBots has no owner restriction so any msg.sender can blacklist addresses
delBot has no owner restriction so any msg.sender can unblacklist addresses
manualswap is unrestricted and callable by any msg.sender
manualsend is unrestricted and lets any msg.sender trigger ETH drain to the fee wallet
renounceOwnership relies on onlyOwner, which compares owner to _msgSender()
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 minutes, creating timestamp dependency
_transfer requires cooldown[from] < block.timestamp, making transfers timestamp dependent
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline
_transfer performs an external swap via swapTokensForEth before _tokenTransfer updates balances
_transfer sends ETH out through sendETHToFee before the balance state updates
_transfer reads the bots blacklist to block blacklisted senders/recipients
_transfer writes and reads the cooldown mapping
_transfer enforces the maximum transaction amount from _maxTxAmount
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve, updating allowances
swapTokensForEth is guarded by lockTheSwap, toggling inSwap around the external call
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap with a user-influenced token amount
sendETHToFee forwards ETH to _feeAddrWallet1
sendETHToFee performs an ETH value transfer that can invoke the recipient's receive fallback
openTrading stores the router in uniswapV2Router
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair
openTrading calls the external factory createPair
openTrading approves the router via _approve
openTrading state is guarded by the tradingOpen flag
addLiq calls addLiquidityETH on the stored router
addLiq enables swapEnabled
addLiq spends the whole contract ETH balance through the external addLiquidityETH call
addLiq enables cooldownEnabled
setBots writes the bots blacklist mapping
setBots iterates the blacklist array using the loop counter i
delBot clears an entry in the bots blacklist mapping
manualswap externally swaps the entire contract balance via swapTokensForEth
manualsend forwards the whole ETH balance via sendETHToFee
transfer calls the private _transfer routine
transferFrom calls the private _transfer routine
transferFrom decreases the allowance via _approve
transferFrom reads the allowance mapping before subtracting
approve delegates writing the allowance to _approve
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from _rOwned[sender] and adds rTransferAmount to the recipient
_takeTeam adds rTeam to the contract reflection balance
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal in a supply-rate sensitive computation
_transfer branches on uniswapV2Pair to decide fees and swap triggering
addLiq passes the contract token balance computed against _maxTxAmount-derived supply
sendETHToFee uses the _feeAddrWallet1 state variable as the transfer destination
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard
_transferStandard mutates reflection balances through _rOwned
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam
_transferStandard applies the fee via _reflectFee
_transferStandard derives all amounts from _getValues
_takeTeam scales the team amount by the current rate from _getRate
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)]
_getValues obtains currentRate from _getRate for reflection math
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token-side fee split
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection-side amounts
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply returned from _getCurrentSupply
_getTValues computes tFee as tAmount * taxFee / 100
_getTValues computes tTeam as tAmount * TeamFee / 100
_getRValues computes rAmount as tAmount * currentRate
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal and divides it by _tTotal
tokenFromReflection divides rAmount by the rate from _getRate
balanceOf reads the reflection balance before conversion
balanceOf converts the reflection balance through tokenFromReflection
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, permanently changing the msg.sender-based access control
_approve writes the allowance mapping
amount parameter flows into transfer and then _transfer
recipient parameter flows into transfer and then _transfer
sender parameter flows into transferFrom and then _transfer
spender parameter flows into approve and then _approve
tokenAmount parameter controls the amount swapped in swapTokensForEth
contractBalance local flows into the manualswap swap call
bots_ parameter is iterated and written into the bots mapping
notbot parameter is written into the bots mapping
tAmount parameter flows into _transferStandard and _getValues
currentRate local flows into the _takeTeam reflection math
rAmount local is subtracted from _rOwned[sender] in _transferStandard

normalization_plan.reason: amount is only a caller-supplied ERC20 amount parameter and has no meaning outside the transfer entrypoint
recipient is a per-call address parameter used solely by the transfer entrypoint
sender is a per-call address parameter used solely by the transferFrom entrypoint
spender is a per-call address parameter bound to the approve entrypoint
tokenAmount is the swap input consumed only by swapTokensForEth
contractBalance is a short-lived local that only feeds the manualswap swap call
bots_ is the blacklist array only consumed by setBots
notbot is the single address only consumed by delBot
i is the loop counter local internal to setBots
tAmount is the token amount consumed by _transferStandard and its value helpers
currentRate is the rate local used inside the reflection bookkeeping routines
rAmount is the reflection amount local applied to _rOwned in _transferStandard
tFee is the fee token local that is accumulated by _reflectFee
tTeam is the team token local credited to the contract by _takeTeam
